pages/book/index.wxmlTeaching example

index.wxml (excerpt)

<view>
  <text>{{title}}</text>
  <button>Reserve this time</button>
</view>
title: "Weekend pottery"
WeChat···　⊙
Green Studio

Weekend pottery

Saturday 14:00 · Pottery workshop

14:00 — 15:30
Reserve this time

{{title}} reads the activity name from page data. The button tag declares an object; separate logic handles its click.

What else works with WXML?

Bind data, rather than duplicate the page: {{title}} displays a field from page data. List and condition directives control which objects appear as data changes.

Use the platform’s components: WeChat uses tags such as view, text, and button. WXML resembles HTML but is not a browser document.

Does declaring a button complete a booking?

Declaring a button does not implement its action. Connect its event to page logic and verify the resulting record; unsupported browser tags and APIs cannot simply be copied.
